agent_explanation: Single ball launched upward at ~41.4 m/s from y=11.6 hits arena ceiling within step 1 and bounces elastically (e=1). With gravity=0 the same bounce conserves energy exactly, but with gravity=9.81 total energy grows every step after the bounce (972->973->1031->1092 J) while controller_work=0. Outgoing speed exceeds incoming (40.47 up to 40.73 down magnitude) and keeps growing. Likely cause: gravity velocity update combined with substepped semi-implicit Euler and ceiling impulse/positional correction double-counts gravitational work or adds spurious g*v*dt energy each substep at high speed, so elastic ceiling collision under gravity injects net energy.
